description: React component for a challenge modal dialog, handling user authentication prompts, validation, and interactions within a web application.

classes.name: ChallengeModal
classes.description: React functional component implementing a challenge modal dialog with prompts and validation.

methods.name: validateValues
methods.description: Validates challenge prompt values, marking empty string inputs as invalid.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Handles submission of challenge prompt values, including validation, UI state updates, and calling application API.

methods.name: onValueChange
methods.description: Updates state when a challenge prompt value changes.

methods.name: cancelChallenge
methods.description: Cancels the challenge if cancelable, and dismisses the modal.
